## The Only Advanced Sofwave™ Treatment in the Riviera Maya

### Next-Generation Ultrasound Lifting in Playa del Carmen & Cancun:

While traditional options in the region—such as standard HIFU, Ultraformer, or Lifthera—have been the historical choice for skin tightening, Althea Wellness Clinic proudly delivers the ultimate evolution in medical rejuvenation.

Sofwave™ uses Breakthrough Synchronous Ultrasound Parallel Beam Technology (SUPERB™) to target the precise depth of the mid-dermis. This FDA-approved innovation stimulates new collagen and elastin far more comfortably and efficiently, without affecting underlying fat or nerve tissue. Experience the premier non-invasive face and neck lift trusted by top medical expertise.

#### **We go beyond aesthetics.**

At Althea Wellness Clinic, we combine advanced aesthetic medicine, regenerative science, longevity-focused wellness, and cutting-edge technology to deliver one of the most advanced and personalized aesthetic and wellness experiences in the Riviera Maya. Our philosophy goes beyond treating isolated concerns—we create customized treatment plans designed to help patients age beautifully, enhance natural beauty, and achieve long-term wellness from the inside out.

Our medical team specializes in Botox® and Botulinum Toxin treatments, Dermal Fillers, Hyaluronic Acid Fillers, Facial Harmonization, Radiesse® and other Collagen Biostimulators, Skin Boosters, Polynucleotides, Medical Weight Management, IV Therapy, and advanced regenerative protocols. ## Frequently Asked Questions:

[DOES THE TREATMENT HURT?, WHAT DOES THE TREATMENT FEEL LIKE?](https://altheawellnessclinic.com/sofwave-playa-del-carmen#)

> Most patients at our Playa del Carmen clinic describe the sensation as a deep heat with brief pulses of energy. Unlike the bone or muscle pain typically associated with traditional HIFU, Sofwave™ incorporates the patented SofCool™ system. This continuous cooling mechanism protects the superficial layers of the skin, maximizing comfort during your non-surgical lifting session. It requires no downtime, and you can resume your activities the same day.

[WHEN WILL I SEE RESULTS?](https://altheawellnessclinic.com/sofwave-playa-del-carmen#)

The first changes in skin quality and luminosity are noticeable from the very first weeks. However, the main effects of this skin tightening appear progressively over the following 6 to 12 weeks. This is the time it takes for the body to activate neo-collagenesis to produce new collagen and elastin, offering a long-lasting and completely natural lifting effect in the Riviera Maya.

[HOW MANY SESSIONS DO I NEED?](https://altheawellnessclinic.com/sofwave-playa-del-carmen#)

One of the most important competitive advantages of Sofwave™ compared to previous technologies in Cancun or Playa del Carmen is that it is performed in a single session per area. Depending on your particular aesthetic goals, previous skin quality, and the level of facial or body flaccidity, our medical team will evaluate if you would benefit from complementary protocols at Álthea Wellness Clinic.

[DOES IT HAVE RECOVERY TIME?](https://altheawellnessclinic.com/sofwave-playa-del-carmen#)

> No, recovery time is zero (zero downtime), making it ideal for the Riviera Maya lifestyle. Although a slight temporary redness may appear in the treated area, the vast majority of patients resume their social or work activities in Playa del Carmen immediately after leaving their appointment.

[IS IT SAFE FOR MY SKIN?](https://altheawellnessclinic.com/sofwave-playa-del-carmen#)

> It is completely safe. Sofwave™ features a synchronous ultrasound technology cleared by the [FDA](https://www.fda.gov/about-fda/fda-en-espanol) for brow lifting, neck tightening, double chin reduction, and the elimination of fine lines. Its precision targets exactly 1.5 mm into the dermis, which guarantees a controlled and non-invasive stimulation without risks of superficial burns or loss of fat volume.

[DOES IT WORK IF I ALREADY HAVE OTHER TREATMENTS?](https://altheawellnessclinic.com/sofwave-playa-del-carmen#)

Yes, of course. In fact, at Álthea Wellness Clinic we consider Sofwave™ to be the ideal upgrade to enhance your aesthetic routine in Playa del Carmen. It is perfectly compatible and complementary with injectable treatments such as botulinum toxin (Botox), hyaluronic acid fillers, collagen biostimulators, medical skincare, and advanced longevity protocols.

[CAN IT REPLACE SURGERY?](https://altheawellnessclinic.com/sofwave-playa-del-carmen#)

> It does not seek to directly replace a surgical facelift in cases of very severe flaccidity, but it is the number one non-surgical lifting alternative for patients who wish to prevent sagging, improve the structural support of the skin, and seek highly elegant and natural changes without undergoing surgery or requiring downtime. In fact, Sofwave™ is excellent for complementing surgical procedures such as facelifts or endolifting. Often, after these procedures, the skin can remain slightly loose or may require quality enhancement, making Sofwave™ a great option to help the skin look its best after surgery.

[WHAT IS THE DIFFERENCE BETWEEN SOFWAVE™ AND TECHNOLOGIES LIKE ULTRAFORMER III, ULTHERAPY OR LIFTERA IN PLAYA DEL CARMEN AND CANCUN?](https://altheawellnessclinic.com/sofwave-playa-del-carmen#)

While Ultraformer, Ultherapy prime and Liftera are popular focused ultrasound (HIFU) treatments in Cancun and Playa del Carmen, they belong to previous generations. Those technologies emit energy in deep, individual thermal points, which often causes discomfort or risks of fat volume loss in the face. [Sofwave™](https://sofwave.com/) uses the patented SUPERB™ technology, which delivers 7 simultaneous ultrasound cylinders superficially and precisely at 1.5 mm into the dermis. This stimulates collagen painlessly and without altering your face's natural fat.

The cost of Sofwave™ in the Riviera Maya varies according to each patient's needs and the areas to be treated (such as full face, neck, or brow lift). ## Different Technologies Treat Different Problems

Patients searching for facial or body tightening, as well as non-surgical lifting solutions, frequently encounter terms like **HIFU, Ultraformer, Liftera, Sofwave™, and Endolifting**. These are distinct technologies designed for specific medical indications rather than interchangeable versions of the same treatment. At Althea Wellness Clinic, we strictly curate our technology standard to offer only the most advanced, comfortable, and award-winning solutions, intentionally moving away from outdated industry options.

*   [Endolifting (Subdermal Laser)](https://altheawellnessclinic.com/endolifting-playa-del-carmen#nav_tabs_content_1787507658608_191)
*   [Sofwave™](https://altheawellnessclinic.com/endolifting-playa-del-carmen#nav_tabs_content_1787507658608_192)
*   [HIFU / Ultraformer / Liftera](https://altheawellnessclinic.com/endolifting-playa-del-carmen#nav_tabs_content_1787507658608_193)

Endolifting delivers controlled laser energy directly from within through an ultra-fine, sterile optical fiber. This internal mechanism allows it to perform a deep, structural reshaping that surface technologies cannot reach, making it the ultimate solution when your aesthetic goals involve a comprehensive combination of skin laxity, stubborn localized fat, and a loss of sharp contours.

While surface devices focus beautifully on the upper tissue layers, Endolifting dynamically contracts the deepest structures. This makes it highly effective for both comprehensive **facial definition** (sculpting the jawline, neck, and eliminating a double chin) and targeted **body contouring** (tightening lax skin on the abdomen, arms, and knees) in a single, outpatient session.

Sofwave™ represents a massive leap forward, completely outperforming traditional HIFU systems. It is a completely non-invasive ultrasound platform that utilizes proprietary **SUPERB™ (Synchronous Ultrasound Parallel Beam) technology** to stimulate a massive foundation of collagen and elastin exactly within the mid-dermis layer.

​

Honored with prestigious global accolades—including the _Cosmopolitan Holy Grail Beauty Award_ and the _NewBeauty Award for Best Ultrasound Innovation_—Sofwave™ provides targeted tissue tightening with maximum safety. Equipped with integrated **SofCool™ cooling technology**, it protects the outer skin layer and ensures an exceptionally comfortable experience. It is the premier choice when skin laxity and overall texture are the primary concerns, without a need to address subdermal fat.

Traditional high-intensity focused ultrasound systems try to deliver energy from outside the skin to selected depths. However, these older technologies are often associated with high levels of patient discomfort, inconsistent results, and the risk of unintended fat volume loss in the face. For these reasons, we do not work with traditional HIFU at Althea.
